launch_authorization: User authorised audit, corrections, deployment and this diagnostic. Training requires a passed server preflight. Pre-run audit revision 1; no real fits or evaluation-block results were seen before this revision.
design_source: docs/CLAUDE_V26_FINAL_HANDOFF_20261025.md section 8 priority 1 (training-side forward-block residual diagnostic) and docs/CLAUDE_V26_ARCHITECTURE_ANALYSIS_20261025.md (seed variance hypothesis); design note docs/KELMARSH_FORWARD_BLOCK_RESIDUAL_V27.md
question: Inside the registered v20-v26 fold-0 fit prefix, refit anchor and residual on the past and score the next block: does gain transfer, does fixed K=5 averaging cancel errors, and does Full beat PowerOnly? This historically developed prefix is not an untouched confirmation set. Averaging benefit cannot identify seed variance as the main cause.
single_change_vs_v26: none in the model or recipe; v26's anchor+residual pipeline is re-run in miniature on forward blocks inside the fold-0 fit period, with the anchor retrained per step (the frozen v20 anchor has seen these labels) and 5 residual seeds per arm
novelty_claim: none; a diagnostic, not a forecasting result or a paper contribution
what_it_can_authorise: only the design of ONE later confirmation protocol (preferably on never-inspected data); never a deployment claim, never an outer evaluation, never a change to v26

timeline.rule: only the registered v20/v25/v26 fold-0 FIT queue, targets before 2016-09-10T07:00 UTC. Earlier v19/Wiki work used portions for selection or memory: this is development evidence, not a previously uninspected period. Read dates first, then numeric CSV rows only inside this prefix; preserve original indices with metadata/NaN padding, with no default fold scaler.
timeline.start: first possible first-target hour = data start + input_len
timeline.block_rule: equal integer-hour lengths of [start, end); edges[i] = start + floor(total_hours * i / blocks)
timeline.step_rule: step k (k = 3..6, 1-based) trains on blocks 1..k-1 and scores block k; a window belongs to a block only if all four targets lie inside it
timeline.inner_split: within the training span [start, edge_{k-1}): fit = windows whose last target < start + floor(0.9 * span_hours); selection = windows with first target >= that cut and last target < edge_{k-1} (the v20 90/10 rule in miniature)
timeline.scaler: per step, mean/std (ddof 0, NaN ignored) of all seven channels over rows (all turbines) with hour-end < the step's fit cut; never uses selection, evaluation or later rows
timeline.seasonal_limit: all blocks are May-September; this tests next-block transfer within summer, not the summer-to-autumn shift seen in v26 outer

anchor.trainer: scripts.train_kelmarsh_backbone_information.fit_arm (v25 production code, the v20 DLinear recipe)

training.tie_policy: strictly lower MAE updates; ties keep the earlier epoch
strictly lower MAE updates; ties keep the earlier epoch

seed_average: plain mean of the 5 selected-epoch residual forecasts of one arm on the same windows; K=5 fixed before any result; not tuned, not weighted

paired_arms.initial_state: AnchoredFull and AnchoredPowerOnly of the same seed and step start from an identical state (verified digest)
paired_arms.device: one device per step for all its fits

evaluation.scored_on: the step's evaluation block only; nothing in the evaluation block is used for any fit, scaler, epoch or threshold
forecasts_registered: each residual seed at its selected epoch
each residual seed at its last epoch (diagnostic only)

pooled_statistics.pool: all evaluation windows of all four steps (disjoint, chronological)
pooled_statistics.estimand: window_uniform; MAE gain CI and RMSE-difference CI reported separately

descriptive_diagnostics: mean correction and mean |correction| per lead
selected vs last epoch on the evaluation block
physical power regimes of the last observed hour (0.1/0.3/0.6/0.9 of rated) with support

decision.R1_residual_transfer: 5-seed mean AnchoredFull jointly better (MAE AND RMSE) than the step's anchor in >= 3 of 4 steps AND pooled MAE-gain CI95 lower bound > 0
decision.R2_averaging_benefit: 5-seed mean AnchoredFull MAE better than mean single-seed MAE in >=3/4 steps. Descriptive cancellation benefit only: convexity already guarantees non-increase; this does not prove H2 or that variance dominates other causes.
decision.R3_auxiliary_attribution: 5-seed mean AnchoredFull jointly better than 5-seed mean AnchoredPowerOnly in >= 3 of 4 steps AND pooled Full-vs-PowerOnly MAE-gain CI95 lower bound > 0
decision.R4_near_term: pooled lead-1 MAE and RMSE of the 5-seed mean AnchoredFull not worse than the anchor (numeric tolerance only)
decision.R5_fixed_seed_transfer: prespecified seed2024 Full jointly better than anchor in >=3/4 steps AND pooled MAE-gain CI lower>0 AND pooled lead1 MAE/RMSE not worse. Required for the nonbagged route; never select a seed on evaluation results.

outcomes.RESIDUAL_MAY_ENTER_CONFIRMATION_WITHOUT_: R1 and R4 and not R2 and R5 (fixed seed2024)

decision.after_STOP: no further residual variant is proposed on the 2016 development windows; the next protocol moves to the information/data budget (multi-year Kelmarsh, sub-hourly end state, turbine identity), each as its own protocol
decision.after_ELIGIBLE: at most one confirmation protocol, frozen before it sees any new data, preferably on never-inspected years; the 2016 outer splits are not re-used as confirmation

forbidden: internal-selection or outer-validation access of any fold
choosing K, lambda, leads, regimes, turbines, epochs or thresholds from evaluation blocks
adding seeds, steps, blocks or architectures after seeing results
